verses.text: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
And I will make of you a great nation, and I will bless you, and make your name great; and be you a blessing.
And God said to Moses: ‘I AM THAT I AM’; and He said: ‘Thus shall you say to the children of Israel: I AM has sent me to you.’
You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbor as thyself: I am the LORD.
HEAR, O ISRAEL: THE LORD OUR GOD, THE LORD IS ONE.
Learn to do well; Seek justice, relieve the oppressed, Judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
But those who wait for the LORD shall renew their strength; They shall mount up with wings as eagles; They shall run, and not be weary; They shall walk, and not faint.
It has been told you, O man, what is good, And what the LORD does require of you: Only to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God.
A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
So teach us to number our days, That we may get us a heart of wisdom.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, And lean not upon your own understanding.
To every thing there is a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:
and should not I have pity on Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand, and also much cattle?’
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
“As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
A faithful friend is a strong defense. He who has found him has found a treasure.
But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and no torment will touch them.
In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

Allah tasks not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it has earned, and against it (only) that which it has deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as you did lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, You, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

For him are angels ranged before him and behind him, who guard him by Allah's command. Lo! Allah changes not the condition of a folk until they (first) change that which is in their hearts; and if Allah wills misfortune for a folk there is none that can repel it, nor have they a defender beside Him.

Your Lord has decreed, that you worship none save Him, and (that you show) kindness to parents. If one of them or both of them attain old age with you, say not "Fie" to them nor repulse them, but speak to them a gracious word.

O mankind! Lo! We have created you male and female, and have made you nations and tribes that you may know one another. Lo! the noblest of you, in the sight of Allah, is the best in conduct. Lo! Allah is Knower, Aware.
But lo! with hardship goes ease,
By the declining day,
Say: He is Allah, the One!

And charity suffers long, and is kind, and envies not, and is not puffed up, seeks not her own, is not easily provoked, thinks no evil, and rejoices not in iniquity but rejoices in the truth, bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
Adam fell that men might be; and men are, that they might have joy.
